test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

My father said to me, "Where__ you have kept__ your books?"
solution:
The correct answer is **'have you kept'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is of **interrogative nature.**
 
• The standard structure : **Have + Subject+ V3+ object.**__
 
• Therefore as per the above structure , 'have you kept' is the correct construction.
 
• We will replace 'you have kept' with ' have you kept' in the following structure.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
